title: רב עוקבא ממישן אמר לרב אשי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Ukva of Meishan spoke to Rav Ashi, Beitzah 36a; Shabbat 43a. There 37b: 'You, close to Rav and Shemuel, follow Rav and Shemuel’s rulings; we shall act like R. Yoḥanan.' This appears to be the early Rav Ashi.
